policies.title: Terms and Conditions
policies.meta_title: Wash4You Terms and Conditions for Laundry Services
policies.meta_description: Read Wash4You terms and conditions to understand our laundry and dry-cleaning process, pickup and delivery policies, and customer rights in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: General
sections.content:
By using Wash4You's services, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. These apply to all garments, shoes, accessories, curtains, carpets, and other items accepted for cleaning, pressing, alteration, or repair.
Wash4You maintains the highest industry standards but cannot guarantee results beyond the limitations inherent in fabrics, dyes, and trims. Customers are advised to read these terms before placing an order.

sections.heading: Scope of Services
sections.content:
• Wash4You provides dry cleaning, laundry, pressing, shoe and bag cleaning, leather and suede care, carpet and curtain cleaning, and related services.
• All services include Free Home Pickup and Delivery across the service area as decided by management from time to time.
• Curtain cleaning includes Free de-Installation and Re-Installation post-cleaning.
• Standard delivery time is 5–7 business days from pickup.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.content:
• Wash4You's maximum liability in case of loss, theft, or damage is limited to five (5) times the service charge of the specific item.
• In case of carpets, curtains and leather goods the maximum liability will be decided by the management for each case and such decision is binding and final.
• Garments or articles with beads, sequins, crystals, buckles, zippers, lace, embroidery, or delicate fabrics are cleaned strictly at the owner's risk.
• Cleaning methods are chosen based on care labels or professional judgment when absent.
• No guarantee of complete stain removal is made, as some stains (e.g., ink, oil, rust, oxidized marks) may be permanent and excessive treatment with stain removing chemicals may risk damage.
• Wash4You is not responsible for: color fading, bleeding, or shrinkage caused by poor-quality dyes or materials; weakness, tears, or fabric damage due to pre-existing conditions; hydrolysis or cracking of PU soles or natural deterioration of leather; scars or natural markings revealed on cleaned leather.
• Internal inspection reports of Wash4You's cleaning unit will be considered final in all disputes.

sections.heading: Claims & Complaints
sections.content:
• Claims for damage, missing, or lost items must be reported within 24 hours of delivery, along with the original bill.
• Claims made after 24 hours will not be entertained.
• All approved claims will be settled at the company's discretion, limited to the stated liability cap.
• Items marked "cleaned at owner's risk" are not eligible for compensation.
• For complaints, email care@Wash4You.in or call +91 9091671666.

sections.heading: Delivery & Storage Policy
sections.content:
• Standard delivery period: 5–7 business days.
• Customers acknowledge that delays due to unforeseen reasons are not grounds for compensation.
• Storage charges: items uncollected beyond 15 days of completion incur 30% of the total bill per month as storage fee.
• Items unclaimed beyond 90 days from completion will be considered abandoned and may be disposed of responsibly.
• Wash4You holds no liability for articles disposed of after this period.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.content:
• All service rates are exclusive of GST and applicable taxes.
• Payment must be made before or at the time of delivery.
• Late payments are subject to 18% annual interest, calculated from the invoice date.
• Accepted payment modes: Cash, Card, UPI, and other approved digital methods.
• Invoices must be checked upon receipt; billing discrepancies must be reported within 24 hours.

sections.heading: Customer Responsibilities
sections.content:
• Customers must check garments for cash, jewellery, keys, papers, or valuables before handing over. Wash4You is not liable for loss of such belongings.
• If garments have been pre-treated with home chemicals, sprays, or other substances, customers must disclose this at pickup.
• Requests for alteration, darning, or repairs are irreversible and non-refundable.
• Correct delivery details must be provided. Wash4You is not liable for misdelivery caused by incorrect addresses or unavailability.
• Customers are required to verify all items upon delivery; post-delivery claims are not accepted.

sections.heading: Communication & Consent
sections.content:
• By using Wash4You services, customers consent to receive WhatsApp, SMS, call, or email notifications for order tracking, billing, and promotional purposes.
• Transactional communication cannot be opted out of.
• Promotional communication can be stopped anytime by emailing care@Wash4You.in.

sections.heading: Curtain Cleaning Policy
sections.content:
• Curtain cleaning includes Free De-Installation and Re-Installation within the service area.
• Wash4You is not responsible for damages to rods, brackets, or fixtures that are weak or faulty prior to service.
• Scheduling is subject to technician availability and may be adjusted with prior notice.

sections.heading: Free Pickup & Delivery Policy
sections.content:
• Free Home Pickup and Delivery apply to orders within the service area as decided by management from time to time.
• Availability depends on logistics routes and operating hours.
• If the customer is unavailable during pickup/delivery, redelivery may be rescheduled at a nominal fee.
• For gated communities, customers must ensure access for Wash4You personnel.

sections.heading: Legal & Jurisdiction
sections.content:
• All disputes and legal matters are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Gurugram Courts, Haryana, India.
• Wash4You reserves the right to revise terms, pricing, and policies without prior notice.
• Wash4You reserves the right to refuse service at its discretion.
• These Terms & Conditions constitute the entire agreement between the customer and Wash4You.

policies.title: Privacy & Security Policy
policies.meta_title: Privacy and Security Policy Wash4You Laundry
policies.meta_description: Read Wash4You's privacy and security policy to understand how we protect your personal data, ensure safe transactions, and maintain confidentiality in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect customer information including: name, address, and contact details; records of services used and payments made; preferences and customer feedback.

sections.heading: How Information is Used
sections.content: Customer data is used to manage logistics including pickups, cleaning, and delivery; send service updates, confirmations, and invoices; enhance service quality; and share promotional offers (not if customer opts out).

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.content: All information is stored on secure, encrypted servers. Payments are processed through PCI-DSS-compliant gateways. We do not retain credit or debit card information. All employees follow strict confidentiality policies.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.content: Information is shared only with logistics and payment partners under secure agreements. Wash4You does not sell or share data for external marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: Our website may use cookies for analytics and user functionality. Cookies do not store sensitive information and can be disabled in browser settings.

sections.heading: Customer Rights
sections.content: Customers may access, update, or request deletion of their personal data by contacting care@wash4you.in.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: Personal data is retained only as long as needed for service and regulatory compliance. Anonymized data may be used for reporting or auditing.

policies.title: Refund & Delivery Policy
policies.meta_title: Refund and Delivery Policy Wash4You Laundry Service
policies.meta_description: Discover Wash4You's refund and delivery policy for laundry and dry-cleaning. We ensure smooth, reliable service for all customers in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery & Pickup
sections.content: We offer complimentary pickup and delivery services within operational areas. Curtain cleaning includes free de-installation and reinstallation. Standard turnaround time is 5 to 7 working days. Missed pickups or deliveries may be rescheduled at a nominal charge.

sections.heading: 2. Storage Policy
sections.content: Items unclaimed for over 15 days will incur a storage charge of 30% of the invoice per month. Items not collected within 90 days will be considered abandoned and may be responsibly disposed of.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds & Compensation
sections.content: Refunds are not offered. Any compensation is limited to five times the service charge of the item. Curtains, leather items, and carpets are not eligible for compensation. Items designated as 'owner risk' (including delicate or embellished garments) are excluded from claims. All claims must be made within 24 hours of delivery.

sections.heading: 4. Service Limitations
sections.content: Full stain removal is not guaranteed. We are not liable for issues resulting from poor-quality materials or construction. For curtain de-installation/removal or re-installation: where rods, brackets or fixtures are weak, faulty or previously damaged, Wash4You is not responsible for any resulting damages. Alteration, darning, and repair services are permanent and non-refundable.

sections.heading: 5. Payment & Disputes
sections.content: Payments are due prior to or upon delivery. Late payments attract 18% annual interest from the invoice date. Disputes related to the invoice must be raised within 24 hours of receipt.
